SASBDB entry SASDK36  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDK36/)

Publication: The Role of Small-Angle X-Ray Scattering and Molecular Simulations in 3D Structure Elucidation of a DNA Aptamer Against Lung Cancer
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1016/j.omtn.2021.07.015

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDK36/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
